competences.description: Summons crows to attack the enemy, inflicting Continuous Damage for 1 turn.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Attacks all enemies with the power of jealousy and weakens the Defense for 2 turns with a 50% chance and absorbs Attack Bar by 20% with a 50% chance. The effect is activated with a 100% chance if the enemy has beneficial effects.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.
Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself

competences.description: Summons comets to attack all enemies 3 to 4 times, each hit applying one of the following effects for 2 turns: Decrease Attack Power, Decrease Attack Speed, Increase Chance of a Glancing Hit, Beneficial Effects Blocked. The target defeated by this attack cannot be revived during battle.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.
The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.

The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.
All beneficial effects will be blocked
Prevents an enemy from being resurrected after being killed.
